title: Preparation Hub
description: Choose a starting task, record what you know, and return to details you still need to gather.

title: Family Hub
description: Record family relationships, shared memories, photographs, and context for the people reading your account.

title: Life Timeline
description: Record dated milestones, the people involved, and why each event matters to you.

title: Executor Hub
description: Work through practical handover steps, find recorded instructions, and identify questions for the relevant professionals.

title: Visual Memories
description: Save photographs and recordings with captions, and explain where larger collections and originals are kept.

title: Subscriptions & Services
description: Record recurring charges, renewal dates, provider contacts, and wishes to close or transfer each service.

title: Document Vault
description: Upload document copies, record where signed originals are kept, and note who to contact about them.

title: Family & Contacts
description: Record family, advisers, and other contacts, how each person can help, and their notification preferences.

title: Final Wishes
description: Record funeral and memorial wishes, arrangements already made, and details still to discuss with family or a provider.
